title: Live Wire
description: Dispatchers need to see shipment status changes the moment they happen, not on the next page refresh. Open a WebSocket connection, trigger a status change from another connection, and confirm the update arrives in real time (FR-801).
successCondition: After connecting to GET /api/tracking/ws?token=<accessToken> and receiving the initial { "type": "connected" } message, calling POST /api/tracking/:id/advance as a dispatcher/admin causes a { "type": "tracking-update", "shipment": { ... } } message to arrive on the socket with status "in_transit" for that shipment id — without polling.
hints: The access token goes in the WebSocket URL's query string (?token=...), not an Authorization header — browsers can't set custom headers on the WebSocket handshake.
Book a shipment first (or use a seeded one) so you have an id to advance.
